data.name: Manodharma
data.gender_notes: Manodharma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from two Sanskrit words, manas (mind) and dharma (duty, nature, law). Manodharma signifies the ego or mind power. The name Manodharma carries the meaning “The Ego or Mind Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manodharma usually hope their child will grow to embody the ego or mind power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength, self-awareness, and wisdom to follow one's spiritual path.
data.etymology: Manodharma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Ego or Mind Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manodharma total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, Manodharma represents an individual's ability to control their thoughts, emotions, and actions, which is considered crucial for living a virtuous life as per the teachings of Hindu scriptures. It reflects the importance of self-discipline, self-restraint, and ethical behavior in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Manodharma symbolizes the balance between the lower self (manas) and the higher self (Atman or Soul). It's an invitation to individuals to be aware of their thoughts, emotions, and deeds, to ensure they align with the divine path as per dharma. It signifies the ongoing spiritual journey towards self-mastery, self-realization, and moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death).
data.spiritual_symbolism: Manodharma signifies the purity and righteousness of one's mind. It is the embodiment of ethical conduct and virtuous thoughts. This name inspires one to strive for mental peace and moral integrity.
